props.html:
The sizes

The sizes Boulder books.

A quartet is for a dance floor that has to fill. Most Boulder evenings are conversation first, in venues and neighborhoods that sit close together, and a solo, duo or trio covers that while staying under the volume ceiling. When a date wants four pieces, we'll say so.

A solo through a patio dinner is the smallest of these and the one Boulder books most. A trio is the biggest size most Boulder venues allow, and it fills a dance floor without needing a stage.

Boulder is a short Front Range drive from Denver, so the travel line is short, and the cost guide sets out the Colorado figures.

props.html:
The venues

Chautauqua to the St Julien, and the houses in between.

Boulder’s private events concentrate in a short list of venues. Chautauqua’s Community House and Dining Hall carry the milestone dinners and anniversaries. The Hotel Boulderado and the St Julien hold the downtown celebrations. Flagstaff House holds the dinner that is booked for its view.

Each has its own reasons to watch the volume. Chautauqua sits inside a residential historic district. The Boulderado and the St Julien put their event floors a corridor away from sleeping guests. Flagstaff House sits up a mountain road with the city below it. At all of them, ask for the venue’s sound policy early, choose a size that sits comfortably under it, and put the number in the contract.

The same applies at home. Boulder neighborhoods sit close, and for half the year the evening wants to be outdoors: a solo or a duo on the patio, quiet enough that the table talks across it, keeps the evening on the right side of the fence line. A trio plays indoors.

props.html:
Questions

Asked about Boulder bookings.

Stage sizes and power for every size are on the technical page, and the Denver page carries the house-booking detail at metro scale.

How late can a band play in Boulder?
As late as your venue's own rules allow, and Boulder venues and neighborhoods set earlier limits than Denver's. Give us the cap and the cut-off at contract, and both go into the plan, including how the last set lands on the cut-off. Signet Artists books private-party musicians in Boulder from Denver.
Does travel from Denver add to a Boulder quote?
One short line on the quote, covering the whole trip there and back. There's no mileage arithmetic and no lodging line, because the band drives home from Boulder, and the fee for the music itself is the same one a Denver host sees.
Can music play outside at a Boulder home?
Yes, at dinner volume, on a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it. Colorado evenings cool fast, so the music comes indoors as the night does.
What does a Boulder booking need for setup and parking?
One van, 45 to 60 minutes of setup through whichever door the venue prefers, and for a solo, about 6 by 4 feet with one dedicated circuit. Parking is the Boulder question worth settling early: downtown is metered, Chautauqua shares its lot with a trailhead that fills on summer evenings, and a house on the Hill shares its curb with students during the university year. Tell us the address and we plan the carry.
When do Boulder dates book?
Most any time, except November and December, which run on the corporate season's clock, decided August through October. New Year's Eve books first.
